description: Deterministic test scenarios for diabetes-research-scientist Research Mentor Interaction Protocol.

scenarios.prompt_summary: User asks why nested CV is needed and requests a detailed simulation.
User gives a clear execution task and asks for no explanation.
User wants to keep a post-index predictor because it increases AUROC.
required_behavior: explain why AUROC does not override validity

scenarios.prompt_summary: User asks whether an unclear NHANES column can be assumed to use mg/dL.
User asks why a non-reproducible controlled-data paper can still be useful evidence.
User asks to interpret the strongest SHAP feature as the cause of diabetes.
required_behavior: show what additional causal evidence would be needed

scenarios.prompt_summary: User asks for a study-design plan and wants to understand why each major decision is made.
required_behavior: avoid turning every minor implementation detail into a lecture

scenarios.prompt_summary: User requests a toy example with numbers.
required_behavior: do not present simulated values as repository results

scenarios.prompt_summary: User asks why the frozen outcome cannot simply be changed to improve performance.
required_behavior: distinguish scientific validity constraint from preference

scenarios.prompt_summary: User asks for a simple definition of calibration slope.
